doc.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

chapter: Jimmy Noon, Nene Quacku and the barbers
title: Buddy Johnson's barbershop and where the Odd Fellows hall stood
summary: Martin places Buddy Johnson's barbershop on Teche Street. Russell asks about the Odd Fellows hall, and the men sort out its location and who lived nearby, including Clay Dash.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Uh, where was that barbershop on Tash and what? About Newton or where?
On Tash between Diana and Lamar. Buddy Johnson barbers.
Is it up near where there's sort of, uh, odd fellas hall there in there someplace where they have parades sometimes? Is it near that?
No, that ain't. That's an odd fellas hall. That's, uh, on Verrett street.

But you know where it is? Right across the street from where, in the same block with that Undertaker. Oh yeah. On Tash Street. Yeah, I know where that is. Right across the street. Yeah, right that's on Tash Street.
Yeah. That's nice way. Yeah. First he was playing the stand over there. Where there? Retroached from the Oddfellas house. Oh, uh, I'm talking about the old Oddfellas house.
Yeah. Well that's where, uh, uh, uh,

Bonnie Dash was, uh, Clay Dash was living right across there too. Clay Dash. He was living there too, right across there too. Now you take, uh, Jimmy Spriggan was living right around in there too. Well, I always knew it was a brand-mothers house. That's all I knew where he was living right around. They take, uh, that girl there, uh, on the corner there. Uh, Villette. Villette. Oh, Villette, yeah. Villette. Villette.
